changes: New: Change Orders for in-progress repair jobs. Agents request additional work found once a job has started (from the accepted-consult row in the admin Consults panel); office must approve in-house before anything reaches the client (mirrors the existing quote office-approval gate); client must always type their full name and e-sign the specific change order before it becomes billable — no emailed-notice-only path, regardless of dollar amount.
New table repair_change_orders (status: pending -> office_approved -> signed, or declined) plus nullable change_order_id on repair_consult_items.

New routes: POST /api/repair-consult/:id/change-orders (agent submit), GET /api/repair-consult/:id/change-orders (history), GET /api/admin/repair-change-orders (admin queue), POST /api/admin/repair-change-orders/:id/office-approve, POST /api/admin/repair-change-orders/:id/decline, GET /api/repair-change-order/:token (public), POST /api/repair-change-order/:token/sign (public e-sign).
New admin UI tab 'Change Orders' in RepairPricingVendorPanel.tsx with approve/decline actions and a request form reachable from ConsultsPanel's accepted rows.
New public client page RepairChangeOrderPage.tsx at /#/change-order/:token — client types full name to sign, same as the existing repair quote accept flow.

On sign: change order folds into repair_consult_items (category=in_house) and recalcConsultTotals recomputes the consult's subtotal/total/deposit_amount/final_amount — the existing 50/50 deposit-required gate is untouched.
__bundleNotes: Purely additive release (new table, new routes, new admin tab, new public sign page) — nothing removed that needs an absence check. No live change orders exist yet at ship time, so no mathChecks (line_total = quantity * unit_rate, and post-sign newTotal = oldSubtotal + line_total) can run against real data until the first one is submitted and signed — verify those manually on the first real change order.
